name: Idlehive
subtitle: Moths glow while you sleep
shortDescription: A calm night-garden idle game. Build roosts, collect glow, take flight, and come back to a colony that kept working.
longDescription:
Lanterns are lit one moth at a time.

Idlehive is a quiet idle game set in a night garden. Tap Hum to gather your first glow, build roosts that glow on their own, and watch a small 3D comb of glowing towers rise while moths drift around it.

### What You Do
- Build eight kinds of roost, from a shy Moth Perch to the deep Starfall Hive.
- Buy charms that make each roost shine harder; every roost doubles its glow at milestone counts.
- Take flight when growth slows. You restart the night but earn lumen, a permanent glow bonus, and spend it on wing perks.
- Collect a nightly gift, finish three small errands a day, and unlock 24 achievements.
- Play through seasons: calendar events such as Firefly Weeks and Harvest Moon change how the garden glows.

### Made for Real Life
- Fully offline. No account, no connection needed.
- Away earnings are honest and capped: your colony glows at half rate for up to four hours while the app is closed, and charms and perks raise both numbers.
- Nothing to buy to progress. No energy bars, no waiting walls.
- Works on iPhone and iPad, with a wide layout on iPad.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
